sentences.en: My placement supervisor allowed me to take a day off.
sentences.zh: 我的实习主管允许我请一天假。

sentences.en: A poor supervisor is the reason for the increased absences.
sentences.zh: 一个不称职的主管是导致缺勤增加的原因。

sentences.en: The supervisor enforced the rules here in this factory.
sentences.zh: 这里的厂长严格执行规章制度。

senses.zh: 监督者, 管理者 形容词: supervisory
